resources.string: Your server hosts the dashboard on your tailnet. Enter its MagicDNS name. This phone has to be signed in to the same tailnet.
The app stores the server name and sends nothing anywhere but that server. Privacy policy: https://github.com/3xDevOps/Aether/blob/main/docs/privacy.md
Enter the server\'s tailnet name, for example my-server.tailnet-name.ts.net
The dashboard is served over HTTPS only. Enter the server\'s tailnet name, or an https:// address.
A server address carries no username or password.
No app on this phone opens %1$s
